name: ouroboros
description: Self-learning for Claude Code: reviews your sessions, turns what is worth keeping into memories and skills, and shows usage, value and cost on a local dashboard.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Learn from sessions: inject the learning protocol and your global profile, run periodic reviews and let the background reviewer write. Off = measure only.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.description: auto: learnings are written right away (undoable). hybrid: only high-confidence facts are written; skills and the rest wait for approval in the dashboard. queue: everything Claude or the reviewer proposes waits for approval. Explicit requests ("remember that…") are always written.

learning_language.title: Language of learnings
learning_language.description: Language memories, profile facts and skills are written in. en: English (recommended: matches most repo conventions and works in every session). pt-BR: Brazilian Portuguese. auto: the language of the conversation.

inloop_review.title: Periodic in-session review
inloop_review.description: Every N turns (and right after a turn that worked through repeated failures) Claude briefly reviews the recent turns and saves what is worth keeping.

review_every_turns.title: Turns between reviews
review_every_turns.description: User turns between periodic in-session reviews.

early_review_failures.title: Failures before an early review
early_review_failures.description: A turn where the same command or file failed this many times before working triggers an in-session review right away (at most one every 5 turns), while the working path is fresh. Other turns wait for the periodic or end-of-session review.

background_review.title: End-of-session review
background_review.description: When a session ends, a small isolated model call reviews the part not reviewed yet: it counts corrections and, with learning on, saves what is worth keeping.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model used by the end-of-session reviewer.

judge_model.title: Evaluation model
judge_model.description: Model that checks each proposed learning against what is already written and composes the edits (screen and editor). haiku is cheap and scored the same as sonnet on the evaluation suite; sonnet costs about 15 times more.

monthly_budget_usd.title: Monthly reviewer budget (USD)
monthly_budget_usd.description: End-of-session reviews stop for the rest of the month once this is spent.
